issue: `KyberSwapStep.computeSwapStep` is a port of the token1 branches of `SwapMath.computeSwapStep` of KyberSwap Elastic (the swap step of the concentrated-liquidity pool). A step must never move the price past its target: `Pool.swap` decides whether it crossed the next tick by comparing the price with the tick's price, so a price beyond the target with the tick not crossed leaves the pool in an inconsistent state (this was exploited on 2023-11-22). With liquidity 529700652, current price 26908681593376338809905220921561871, target 27180014754403994732126507336932861, fee 300 and an exact input of 1816821696332 units of token1 (one unit below the amount that reaches the target), the step returns the next price 27180014754675749645719300096015422, above the target. An exact-output step also ends below its target: with liquidity 3391575, current price 316297169264893702192209790286789, target 312702479284222327139907330712089, fee 10 and an output of 153872678 units of token1 (specified amount -153872678), the next price is 312702477359235854013914346495714. The results on most inputs look correct.

source.function: SwapMath.computeSwapStep, calcReachAmount, estimateIncrementalLiquidity, calcIncrementalLiquidity, calcFinalPrice, calcReturnedAmount (isToken0 = false); QuadMath.getSmallerRootOfQuadEqn and sqrt; the step target and the tick-crossing test of Pool.swap
